failure_boundary: An executed mutation changed the HMM MSV calibration mu, but the generated grader omitted comparing that promised field. Final review requested revision; the single global quality repair had already been used for the specification. The factory stopped without packaging or a solver attempt.
interpretation: A generated-grader defect was detected and rejected within the agreed repair budget; this is not a defect in the original notebook, an infrastructure failure or a failed solver answer.
